review.reviewer: agent:batio3-static-correspondence (construction and adversarial self-review, not independent ferroelectric/measurement specialist)
review.rationale: Source-bound diagnostic of one bulk electroded specimen. Conditional polynomial mismatch is not material rejection; mechanical ensemble, joint/bare coefficients, internal field, finite-frequency/background/readout and uncertainty remain unadmitted.

question: How far does the old C/Phi/Pi dictionary match the selected bulk BaTiO3 electric-field/LCR specimen, and which potential, ensemble, port and observation bridges fail or remain unknown?

output.quantity: Source-fact subset, nominal SI transformations, conditional sextic witness and scoped state/potential/ensemble/port/readout/mechanics verdicts
output.unit: declared SI nominal geometry/temperature/frequency and source polynomial units; normalized exact identities and correspondence labels, not a physical accuracy score
output.domain: Wang2006 arXiv v1 [001] Pt-electroded BaTiO3 nominal2x2x0.3mm3 plate,135degC,10kHz LCR under DC bias. Li2005/Wang2007/Jiang2016 are separately scoped convention/theory context, not a merged calibration tuple. Static conditional reduction requires aPhi>0,referencePhi=0,zero mechanical source and a matched ensemble.
output.accuracy: Exact symbolic identities and rational conversion of printed decimals, never zero physical uncertainty. Conditional local analytic series has no admitted specimen amplitude range/error certificate. No fitted Core curve, physical residual interval or approximation percentage.

model.assumptions: Current Core potential only; C=P/P0 is a candidate linear normalization, Phi requires an admitted compatible mechanical mode. Source native potential density and relaxed/bare joint energy are distinct. Existing Argument18/21-29 force dictionary, boundary/Schur and reduction limits reused, not rerun.
model.approximation: Near-zero static implicit-function expansion is conditional mathematics, not elimination of prepared Phi/Pi dynamics. Native source-fit polynomial is a diagnostic point model with unknown covariance/uncertainty. No approximation to actual material claimed without force/curvature bounds, ensemble and readout admission.
model.initial_boundary: Native specimen bias/temperature protocol only; actual mounting/clamping/internal field and zero-drive write-release preparation unresolved. No N4 geometry, inertia, chain boundary or quantum-comparator bounds transferred.
model.drive_environment: Voltage source, Pt electrodes, temperature chamber and LCR receiver/circuit distinct from sample. Terminal command not identified with internal force or normalized J_C. Finite-frequency probe/loading/heating unknown, not zero.
model.parameters: Printed Wang2006 Table I eighth-order Both-phase fit and nominal specimen conditions from source-input. Li selected coefficients converted by4/6/8 in a separate context, not used to fill Wang alpha/covariance. No Jiang DFT parameter used to calibrate specimen. Symbolic aPhi,bPhi,g,P0/fscale and strain stiffness/coupling express conditional relations, not new fitted Core constants.

data_policy.holdout_policy: Existing published protocol and source-model fits, exposed during planning; no reserved/blind holdout or new fit. Follow-up2007 explicitly builds on2006, Li potential lineage not independent replication, DFT context not specimen data. No graph digitization or raw-trace inference.

observation.source_state: Physical sample polarization/elastic and other unresolved degrees; old C/Phi/Pi are candidate views, not admitted independent copies.
observation.generated_trace: No old sigma/R trace identified with entropy, sample state or instrument record.
observation.carrier: Terminal field/charge/current signal via electrodes and circuit; full transfer unknown, not a new information substance.
observation.observer_state: LCR receiver and voltage-drive electronics have loading/calibration states not reconstructed or assigned zero effects.
observation.readout: Source-reported dielectric response at10kHz versus DC bias, not direct signed P, strain or Pi. Absolute/relative permittivity/background and circuit definitions checked conditionally; no full-state inversion claimed.
observation.backaction: AC/bias loading, screening, interface/thermal and mounting influence unknown. Readout metadata do not create physical force; real receiver-to-sample routes remain explicit.
observation.frame: [001] specimen orientation; nominal plate geometry,135degC and10kHz kept in one context. No mixing with thin film or zero-T/fixed-D parameters.
observation.time_convention: Finite frequency10000Hz and20000*pi rad/s are not DC without a band certificate. No dynamics/time integration, lifetime, inertia or damping inference.
observation.product_level: Internal extracted physical-source diagnostic; source uncertainty and correspondence still INCOMPLETE

error_budget.unit: declared SI nominal geometry/temperature/frequency and source polynomial units; normalized exact identities and correspondence labels, not a physical accuracy score
error_budget.numerical: Exact rational/symbolic arithmetic for source decimal points and local series; printed digits are not hard physical intervals.
error_budget.approximation: No finite specimen range or total force/curvature bound; sextic residual contribution is not a full error estimate.
error_budget.measurement: Geometry/source-fit/covariance/internal-field/readout/DC/background errors UNKNOWN, not zero; no physical acceptance limit invented.
error_budget.systematic: Source version/ensemble,relaxed coefficient double counting,multiple modes and scalar/noninjective readout remain explicit.
error_budget.omissions: No fitted UET curve,new dynamics,material,trajectory,quantum or lifetime; missing contributions not bounded negligible.
error_budget.dependence: Source fit and follow-up not independent evidence. Li/Jiang context not calibration. Conditional source-polynomial difference not certified material falsification.
error_budget.acceptance: Source-linked scoped verdicts plus conditional analytic witness and unknown prerequisites; exact tests/identities/completeness support diagnostic reproducibility only.
